name: b51-sails-torn
js: const B=g.boats; const y=B.spawnNear('mirissa46',{x:120,z:-1320,yaw:0}); if(y){ y.mode='anchored'; y.place(120,-1320,-1.3,true); y.berth={x:120,z:-1320,yaw:-1.3}; y.setSailsVisible(true); for(let i=0;i<16;i++) y.sailHit(i%y.sails.length,{x:0.15+Math.random()*0.7,y:0.1+Math.random()*0.7}); window.__dbg={id:y.id,holes:y.sails.map(q=>q.holes),tear:y.sails.map(q=>q.tear)}; }

name: b51-wake-run
js: const B=g.boats; const y=B.spawnNear('dondra26',{x:110,z:-1382,yaw:-1.5708}); if(y){ y.place(110,-1382,-1.5708,true); y.u=16; y.route=[{x:-400,z:-1382}]; y.role='free'; for(let i=0;i<60;i++) B.update(0.05,g.player); window.__dbg={x:y.x,z:y.z,u:y.u}; }

name: b51-wreck-burning
js: const B=g.boats; const y=B.spawnNear('hikkaduwa30',{x:125,z:-1330,yaw:0}); if(y){ y.mode='anchored'; y.place(125,-1330,0.6,true); y.berth={x:125,z:-1330,yaw:0.6}; y.damage(y.maxHp*2,'engine',null,'debug'); for(let i=0;i<80;i++) B.update(0.05,g.player); window.__dbg={id:y.id,sink:y.sink,mode:y.mode}; }
